dataset_uri.title: Dataset Uri
dataset_uri.description: The world to resolve against: `wikidata://public` (default), `wordlift://dataset/me` (your WordLift graph, read with your key), `inline` (with `dataset`), or a comma-separated ordered list such as `wordlift://dataset/me,wikidata://public` (your entities first, Wikidata for the rest).

type.title: Type
type.description: Caller's type hint, e.g. Person, Organization

id.title: Id
id.description: Identity in the dataset: Q312, wd:Q312 or a Wikidata entity URI

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: Identities retrieved by the caller; if omitted the engine retrieves against dataset_uri

mentions.title: Mentions
mentions.description: Explicit spans; if omitted the engine detects mentions

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: NER threshold when the engine detects mentions

items.title: UserEntity
items.description: An entity of your own vocabulary. `id` is echoed back as given.

types.description: schema.org types, e.g. Organization, Person, Place

dataset.description: An inline vocabulary (up to 5,000 entities): the answer is one of these ids or unresolved. Implies dataset_uri `inline`.
